description: This file defines the LeaveComment entity class used in the OrangeHRM system for managing leave comments. It includes properties mapping to database columns, ORM annotations, and getter/setter methods for comment-related data.

classes.name: LeaveComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave comment in the HRM system, including properties for comment content, creator information, related leave record, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the leave comment.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Retrieves the Leave entity associated with this comment.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates this comment with a specific Leave entity.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Gets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment.
